provenance.summary: The RF Router configuration for the PR 38 primary outer-fold routers, owned by the RF arm and versioned here. The forest hyperparameters are the historical values, copied once and exactly; no run reads them from a GLASS-side artifact. The constraints are not part of this profile: they come only from the frozen shared contract. The fold and eligibility settings are the approved F17 primary (gate G1).
provenance.derivation: rf_params equal the historical GLASS-arm RF result's params, which the black-box notebook loaded at run time (RF_PARAM_SOURCE='artifact', tuning.legacy.load_rf_params_from_artifact) and which the historical RF Router artifact records as config.rf_params (baseline MANIFEST routers.blackbox.metadata.rf_params). pass2_rf_params null: Pass 2 reuses the Pass 1 settings, as historically. n_inner_folds 5, stratify_oof true and remainder_min_size 500 are the historical settings. mode, eligibility, eligibility_folds, n_oof_folds and random_state are the F17 primary. verbose and validate_nested are run-time options outside the profile: they print, or add the nested diagnostic after the fit, and never change a selection.
provenance.tuning: Optuna TPE, seed 42, 200 trials, mean 5-fold ROC-AUC CV on all of X_eng_train (features engineered on the full training set with its labels), run once in the GLASS notebook. No nested tuning in PR 37 (decision M8).
exposure: The tuning CV saw all training rows, so each outer fold's held-out labels helped choose the hyperparameters of the router that routes it.
The tuning CV saw target-encoded features informed by its own validation labels.
The values were fixed before any corrected PR 38 result existed. No test-derived value was read; the artifacts also store historical test metrics, which were not used.
limitations: Not independently tuned for the shared contract or for nested eligibility; the values are a historical anchor, not an optimum.
The RF Router uses these values in both forests, while GLASS uses an RF only to order its rule search, so any resulting optimism plausibly favours RF.
GLASS records the same six values for its own ranker (glass_router_primary_v1). The two arms share hyperparameter values, never a fitted estimator.
provenance.relation_to_pr38: PR 38 builds every primary RF Router config with rf_router.profile.rf_primary_config(contract): this frozen profile (pinned fingerprint) plus the frozen contract's constraints. A different value needs a new profile version, approval and disclosure before corrected outer out-of-fold results are inspected.

approval.note: Frozen in PR 37 Commit 4, Step 4D; formally approved by Phillip Harris on 2026-11-05 (decision M8: historical values preserved exactly, owned by the RF arm). Takes effect when Commit 4 is created after local validation.
